style: An exploratory tester's notebook: green engineering graph paper, a red margin with entry labels, Spectral headings over typewritten notes, a pink highlighter, and an index-card session log that types itself in.

concept.idea: Exploratory testing runs in timed sessions with a charter and timestamped notes, so the site is the tester's notebook: each section an entry in the margin, the scope written as a charter, the work as a session log.
concept.signature: The hero index card: a session clock runs from zero while each area the agency explores is stamped and typed in, line by line, with a blinking caret; at rest the clock keeps counting and the caret waits on the last line. Complete and static without JS motion.
concept.motionVerb: type and timestamp: characters arrive, the clock advances, brackets open

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with sample and long.json, every focus stop visible, skip link first, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. Most composed frames of the batch (graph paper, margin, typed log); typewriter body text is slower to read at length.
